Computer Science AB at Dartmouth College

What Dartmouth College asks of applicants to Computer Science AB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Dartmouth College courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Standardized testing required
  • Students at high schools in the U.S.: SAT or ACT required (no preference; superscored)
  • Students at high schools outside the U.S.: SAT/ACT, three AP exams, IB Diploma results (predicted or final), A-Level results (predicted or final), or final results of an equivalent standardized national exam
Verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines · Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines · Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines
English language
  • English proficiency exam score required if your first language is not English and your curriculum has not been delivered in English for at least two years
  • Accepted:
    • TOEFL (incl. iBT Special Home Edition), IELTS (incl. IELTS Indicator), Duolingo, Cambridge English
    • TOEFL MyBest scores and TOEFL Essentials not accepted
  • No minimum required scores

Dartmouth publishes the scores most successful applicants achieve, not minimum scores, so no score is shown as a requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: English language proficiency FAQ
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: Apply to Dartmouth
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Dartmouth expects the most demanding curriculum available; in schools following a US-based curriculum, five “major” subjects are required through the senior year. Recommended minimum: English 4 years (writing-intensive literature preferred); mathematics 4 years, through calculus for students interested in engineering and STEM; history and social science 3 years; science 3 years of laboratory science (4 including physics for students considering engineering); foreign language 3 years of a single language (4 preferred). Students are admitted without a major designation, so this applies whatever the intended major.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: High school courses FAQ
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
For students at schools outside the U.S., predicted or final A-Level results (Cambridge, Pearson or UK-based providers) fulfil Dartmouth’s testing requirement. Predictions must come from a school official; at least three A-Levels encouraged; official final certificates required before enrolment.
Verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
For students at schools outside the U.S., predicted or final IB Diploma Programme scores (1–7 scale) fulfil Dartmouth’s testing requirement. Predictions (including EE and TOK where offered) must come from a school official; final scores required before enrolment.
Verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: students at schools outside the U.S. may fulfil the testing requirement with three AP exams (at least one math/science and one history/social science/English encouraged)
  • Final results from an equivalent standardized national exam (e.g. WASSCE, CAPE, French Baccalaureate, CBSE, ICSE, KCSE) also fulfil it for students outside the U.S.; predicted national results do not
Verified19 Oct 2026Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines · Dartmouth: Testing Guidelines
Other requirements
  • Dartmouth Writing Supplement required
  • Peer Recommendation recommended; art portfolio optional
  • Alumni interviews offered where available — not having one is no disadvantage; InitialView interviews encouraged if you have one
